experiment_data.hypothesis: Two-stage SFT with RAGEN-format data (v4). From exp008_sft checkpoint, fine-tune with v4 data (RAGEN Turn/State/Reward structure, fixed system prompt with consistent <answer> tag instruction). LR=5e-6, 2 epochs. Validate via RAGEN val_before_train (not eval_sft_fast). Pass: RAGEN val success >= 10%, action_is_valid >= 85%.
experiment_data.notes: RAGEN 格式 SFT 成功。两项 pass criteria 均达标：RAGEN val success=25% (≥10%), action_is_valid=87.5% (≥85%)。对比 exp019b：RAGEN val 从 0% 提升到 25%（格式对齐修复生效）。eval_sft_fast success=0%（预期，因模型已对齐 RAGEN 格式而非 <answer> 标签格式）。训练 320 steps / 2 epochs / 47.8min，final loss=0.038。Checkpoint: /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp021_ragen_sft_v4/final/
